intro: College exposure is built into the weekend. Friday night before play, athletes can do a recruiting combine and a recruiting seminar, and college coaches follow the action in person and on the livestream.

combine.title: Recruiting Combine
points: Position drills, then group drills, built for maximum touches
Every player gets equal reps, with no favoritism by club or school
Livestreamed to college coaches who can't attend in person
Players get the footage afterward for their own recruiting
Open to athletes whose school isn't in the tournament
combine.status: 2027 combine registration opens in the spring.

seminar.title: Recruiting Seminar
points: College coaches from multiple levels share what they look for
Recruiting profiles, highlight videos, social media and building exposure
NCAA rules, scholarship basics, and where to be by grade
For athletes, parents and high school coaches
seminar.pricingNote: 2026 pricing: $20 single pre-sale, $175 team pre-sale, $30 at the door. Every attendee needs a ticket, including parents, coaches and siblings.
seminar.status: 2027 seminar tickets go on sale in the spring.
seminar.ledBy: Led by CJ Roberts, founder of 7 Athletics & Consulting, former college coach and current college program consultant.
